data.text:
DAVAO HAS WORST TRAFFIC IN THE PH 🚗

Davao City continues to be the most traffic-congested city in the Philippines, placing 12th worldwide in the 2025 TomTom Traffic Index. 

The report also identified the Philippines as the most congested country in Asia.

Manila likewise appeared on the list, ranking 40th globally, though it recorded a slight improvement compared to the previous year.
